segments.sn35.115:1.1: “Santi, bhikkhave, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.115:1.2: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn35.115:1.3: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu baddho cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu, āvāsagato mārassa, mārassa vasaṃ gato, paṭimukkassa mārapāso.
segments.sn35.115:2.2: santi, bhikkhave, manoviññeyyā dhammā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.115:2.3: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn35.115:2.4: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu baddho manoviññeyyesu dhammesu, āvāsagato mārassa, mārassa vasaṃ gato, paṭimukkassa mārapāso.
segments.sn35.115:3.1: “Santi ca kho, bhikkhave, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.115:3.2: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn35.115:3.3: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mutto cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi, nāvāsagato mārassa, na mārassa vasaṃ gato, ummukkassa mārapāso.
segments.sn35.115:3.4: Mutto so mārabandhanena na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato…pe….
segments.sn35.115:4.2: santi, bhikkhave, manoviññeyyā dhammā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.115:4.3: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati –
segments.sn35.115:4.4: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mutto manoviññeyyehi dhammehi, nāvāsagato mārassa, na mārassa vasaṃ gato, ummukkassa mārapāso.
segments.sn35.115:4.5: Mutto so mārabandhanena na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato”ti.

lines: Mārassa vasaṃ gatoti tividhassāpi mārassa vasaṃ gato.
Paṭimukka’ssa mārapāsoti assa gīvāya mārapāso paṭimukko pavesito.
Tato eva devaputtamārassapi vasaṃ gatoti sakkā viññātuṃ.
